name: Enchanters
description: The Enchanters were a 1950s New York City youth street gang with factions in East Harlem (Manhattan), Astoria (Queens), and Corona (Queens). The East Harlem chapter, centered on East 100th Street, was implicated in a murder in February 1955. The Astoria chapter battled the Parkside Gents, Hobo Lords, and Queensbridge Projects gangs. The Corona chapter, formed in the late 1950s, had sub-divisions including the Little, Baby, Big, and Lady Enchanters, and allied with the Chaplins against the Dukes in the 1961 Newtown High School fight.
